decisions.reason: As a non-core accelerator program rather than a core recycling technology, it is the easiest option to abandon and free managerial attention and funds for the firm's equipment and R&D pipeline.
Despite commercialization uncertainty, it is presented as a flagship direction, so keeping it on the market preserves upside while technical and market learning continues.
This flagship decontamination plant is close to the firm's engineering and waste-treatment capabilities, and one year is too early to abandon it before demand signals become clearer.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the firm's core modular, decentralized recycling strategy especially well, so it is the least likely of the new launches to be withdrawn quickly.
